scope: Item-specific documentation checks on 2026-11-04, not installed-product tests, current prices, or blanket platform/data-policy verification. Missing fields remain unknown.

mode: 本地 API 与云模型分开看
Distinguish the local API from cloud models
access: localhost:11434 的本地 API 无需鉴权。云模型、发布/私有模型操作需登录，直连云 API 需 key。
The localhost:11434 API needs no authentication. Cloud models and publishing/private-model operations require sign-in; direct cloud API access requires a key.
platform: 官方 FAQ 分列 Windows、macOS、Linux 配置；具体 GPU、模型与后端另查。
The FAQ documents Windows, macOS and Linux configuration. Check the GPU, model and backend separately.
io: generate 接口接收提示词并返回 JSON/流式响应；这是 API 响应，不等于应用的文件导出。
The generate endpoint accepts a prompt and returns JSON/streamed responses. API output is not an application file-export feature.
billing: 本次未核对当前收费。区分本地运行成本、模型许可与云服务计费，不用本地 API 无鉴权推断云端免费。
Current charges were not checked. Separate local running costs, model licences and cloud billing; unauthenticated local access does not establish free cloud usage.
data: 本地地址也能调用云模型；数据处理位置取决于选择的模型与配置。留存/训练政策本次未复核。
A local endpoint can call a cloud model. Processing location depends on the selected model/configuration; retention and training policies were not reviewed here.

mode: 已下载模型的本地聊天、文档与服务流程
Local chat, document and server workflows with downloaded models
access: 账号与服务鉴权要求本次未专门核对；离线可用不等于所有服务端配置都免鉴权。
Account and server-authentication requirements were not checked separately. Offline operation does not establish unauthenticated access for every server configuration.
platform: 官方列 Windows、macOS 与 Linux。Mac 要求 Apple Silicon、macOS 14+，不支持 Intel Mac；其他架构/发行版限制回原文核对。
Windows, macOS and Linux are documented. Macs require Apple Silicon and macOS 14+; Intel Macs are unsupported. Check other architecture/distribution limits in the original.
io: 离线文档说明本地 server 返回 OpenAI-like 响应对象；聊天文件导出方式未核对。
Offline documentation describes OpenAI-like response objects from the local server. Chat file-export methods were not checked.
billing: 当前软件条款、商业使用与收费方式未核对；不把模型可下载当作许可或费用结论。
Current software terms, commercial use and charges were not checked. Downloadability establishes neither licence scope nor cost.
data: 官方称已下载模型的聊天、本地文档处理和本地 server 可离线；搜索/下载模型、运行时和更新会联网。插件与外部工具另查。

The official page states that downloaded-model chat, local document processing and the local server can work offline. Model/runtime discovery/downloads and updates use the network. Check plugins/external tools separately.

mode: 源码、预编译包与服务入口
Source, prebuilt packages and server entry points
access: 所选服务配置的鉴权要求未核对；不能因为源码公开就推断部署后没有访问控制。
Authentication for a selected server configuration was not checked. Public source does not determine deployed access controls.
platform: 官方提供安装脚本、releases、Docker 和构建说明。本项未核对具体操作系统/后端组合，筛选保留未知。
Official installation scripts, releases, Docker and build guidance exist. Exact OS/backend combinations were not checked here and remain unknown in filters.
io: 当前 README 展示 llama cli / llama serve；具体 API/导出契约未在本项复核。不能据此断言旧命令已移除。
The current README shows llama cli / llama serve. Exact API/export contracts were not reviewed here; this does not establish removal of older commands.
billing: 本次未审阅具体分发与托管服务条款；运行硬件、模型许可、托管服务分别核对。
Specific distribution/hosting terms were not reviewed. Check hardware costs, model licences and hosted services separately.
data: 本地运行器也可以配置远程模型来源或服务；部署网络、日志与留存设置未核对。
Local runners can use remote model sources or services. Deployment networking, logging and retention settings were not checked.

mode: 编辑器基础功能，不代表 AI 扩展
Core editor features, separate from AI extensions
access: 本项未核对登录与同步要求；Copilot 等扩展的账号要求另查。
Sign-in/sync requirements were not checked here; inspect Copilot and other extensions separately.
platform: 官方列 Windows、macOS、Linux，具体受支持版本与架构以 requirements 为准。
Windows, macOS and Linux are documented, subject to the versions/architectures in requirements.
io: 编辑源文件并显式保存到磁盘；自动保存可另设。这是文件编辑，不是 AI 生成质量保证。
Edit source files and save explicitly to disk; Auto Save is configurable. File editing is not evidence of AI-generation quality.
billing: 当前软件分发条款与 AI 扩展/服务费用未核对，不能混成一个价格结论。
Current distribution terms and AI extension/service fees were not checked; do not combine them into one price claim.
data: 基础文件编辑与扩展/AI 提供方的数据流分开核对；遥测、同步、留存与训练政策本项未复核。
Check core file editing separately from extension/AI-provider data flows. Telemetry, sync, retention and training policies were not reviewed here.

mode: 官方帮助现称 Gemini Notebook；未登录验证账号迁移
Help now uses Gemini Notebook; account migration was not tested
access: 官方说明需登录 Google 账号；组织账号可能需管理员启用，年龄和地区也有限制。
Official guidance requires Google sign-in. Organization accounts may need admin access; age and region restrictions also apply.
platform: 本项核对浏览器帮助；移动端可用范围需单独看官方说明，不推断所有地区都可用。
This check covers browser help. Check mobile availability separately; no all-region availability is implied.
io: 笔记可 Export to Docs，生成新的 Google Doc；在新 Docs 内修改不会同步回原笔记。
Notes can Export to Docs, creating a new Google Doc. Changes in that Doc do not sync back to the original note.
billing: 方案、额度与组织合同本次未复核。
Plans, quotas and organization contracts were not reviewed here.
data: 本项只核对账号、网页入口与笔记导出；留存、反馈与组织政策需分别回当前条款核对。
This item checks accounts, browser access and note export only. Review retention, feedback and organization policies against current terms separately.
sources: Gemini Notebook 使用条件 / Access conditions

mode: 付费网页搜索；不是无账号服务
Paid web search, not an account-free service
access: FAQ 明确搜索需账户。Privacy Pass 是已获授权的令牌方式，不表示没有账户。
The FAQ requires an account for search. Privacy Pass is token-based authorization, not absence of an account.
platform: 本项确认网页搜索与浏览器使用说明；原生应用/扩展的平台要求另查。
This check covers web search and browser guidance; inspect native-app/extension platforms separately.
io: 输入查询，浏览搜索结果；文件导出契约本次未核对。
Enter a query and browse search results; a file-export contract was not checked.
billing: 官方 FAQ 称为付费搜索服务；不收录当前单价，试用、订阅和 API 计费须分别核对。
The official FAQ describes paid search. No current prices are stored; check trial, subscription and API billing separately.
data: 本项不核验隐私宣传；查询、留存与令牌使用回当前政策确认，不把 Privacy Pass 当作无条件匿名保证。
Privacy marketing was not verified here. Check query handling, retention and token use in current policies; Privacy Pass is not an unconditional anonymity guarantee.

mode: 账号内 Assets 的批量下载
Batch downloads of assets in an account
access: 账号创建文档与账号内 Assets 下载流程已核对；组织权限另查。
Account creation and the in-account Assets download workflow are documented; inspect organization permissions separately.
platform: 本项核对网页端 Assets 流程；不替所有移动端和浏览器版本作兼容承诺。
This check covers the web Assets workflow, not every mobile app or browser version.
io: 选择账号内多个素材/文件夹后 Download，批量包为 ZIP；不是对所有模型视频格式或分辨率的承诺。
Select account assets/folders and Download a ZIP batch. This does not establish every model’s video formats or resolutions.
billing: 当前积分、方案、导出限制与水印本次未核对。
Current credits, plans, export restrictions and watermarks were not checked.
data: 这是账号内云端素材下载流程；上传内容的留存、训练与团队访问政策本次未复核。
This is an account-based cloud-asset download workflow. Upload retention, training and team-access policies were not reviewed here.

mode: 本条只记录 GitHub Advisory Database 的说明范围；不含 Dependabot 配置、告警时效、账号权限或其他 GitHub 产品。
This entry records the GitHub Advisory Database page only, not Dependabot configuration, alert timing, account permissions or other GitHub products.
access: 登录与仓库权限要求本条未核对；不能据此推断支持或不支持。
Sign-in and repository permissions were not checked in this entry; this establishes neither support nor lack of support.
platform: 只核对说明页文本；网页、API 与 Actions 各入口的可用范围未在本条复核。
Only the overview page was read; availability across the web UI, API and Actions was not reviewed in this entry.
io: 文档口径：以生态与包为范围返回带公告标识的已知漏洞条目；告警导出与集成方式未核对。
As documented, advisories cover ecosystems and packages with advisory identifiers; alert export and integrations were not checked.
billing: 本条未核对收费；数据库说明与产品订阅分开看，不互相推断。
No charges were checked in this entry; the database documentation and product subscriptions stay separate.
data: 说明页称该数据库收录开源包中已知安全漏洞与恶意软件条目，社区提交由 GitHub Security Lab 复核，并列出 npm、PyPI、Maven、NuGet、Go、Rust、RubyGems、Composer、Hex、Pub、Swift 与 GitHub Actions 等生态。这是文档口径与核验日期，不是本次实测。

The page states the database lists known security vulnerabilities and malware in open-source packages, that community contributions are reviewed by the GitHub Security Lab, and names ecosystems including npm, PyPI, Maven, NuGet, Go, Rust, RubyGems, Composer, Hex, Pub, Swift and GitHub Actions. This is a dated documentation claim, not a test run.
sources: GitHub Advisory Database 说明 / Advisory database overview

mode: 只记录自托管部署页的组件与存储范围；不含云端区域、留存政策、价格或完整功能权限矩阵。
Covers the self-hosting page's components and storage only; not cloud regions, retention policies, prices or the full feature/permission matrix.
access: 自托管的账号与 SSO 由部署方配置，登录要求随部署方式而变；本条未核对默认安装的鉴权状态。
Self-hosted accounts and SSO are configured by the operator, so sign-in requirements vary by deployment; the default installation's authentication state was not checked here.
platform: 文档分列 Docker Compose、Kubernetes（Helm）与 VM 部署路径；本条未逐一举实测。
The docs list Docker Compose, Kubernetes (Helm) and VM paths; none were executed in this entry.
io: 文档口径：观测数据存 ClickHouse，事务数据存 PostgreSQL，缓存与队列用 Redis 或 Valkey，原始事件与多模态附件存 S3 或兼容对象存储；导出格式未在本条核对。

As documented: observability data in ClickHouse, transactional data in PostgreSQL, cache and queue in Redis or Valkey, raw events and multi-modal attachments in S3 or compatible object storage. Export formats were not checked here.
billing: 文档提到部分附加功能需要 license key；价格与授权范围本条未核对。
The page notes that some add-on features require a license key; pricing and licence scope were not checked here.
data: 自托管时数据落在部署方选定的上述存储里，本条据此记录组件范围；云端方案的数据处理、留存与训练政策未复核。
Self-hosted data lands in the storage the operator selects, which is the component scope this entry records. Cloud data processing, retention and training policies were not reviewed.

mode: 只记录快速开始页的用法口径：本地按 pytest 风格运行评测文件、判定所需的模型凭据。不含完整指标清单与 CI 集成细节。
Covers the quickstart only: running eval files locally pytest-style and the model credentials judging needs. Not the full metric list or CI integration details.
access: 快速开始要求设置 OPENAI_API_KEY 或 TYPESAFE_API_KEY 之类凭据才能调用判定模型；平台账号登录范围本条未核对。
The quickstart requires credentials such as OPENAI_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY for the judging model; platform account sign-in was not checked in this entry.
platform: 本条只核对 deepeval test run 的文档口径，未在本机执行，也未复核各操作系统支持矩阵。
This entry records the documented deepeval test run behaviour only; nothing was executed locally and the operating-system support matrix was not reviewed.
io: 文档口径：输入测试文件与被测输出，输出指标判定与报告；结果导出格式未在本条核对。
As documented: test files and outputs under test in, metric verdicts and reports out. Result export formats were not checked here.
billing: 凭据对应的模型调用费用与相关托管方案价格本条未核对；开源包本身不等于运行成本为零。
Model-call charges for those credentials and hosted plan prices were not checked; an open-source package does not establish zero running cost.
data: 评测数据是否离开本机取决于所选判定模型与配置；本条未核对留存与训练政策，也不把厂商隐私表述当作实测。

Whether evaluation data leaves the machine depends on the chosen judge model and configuration. Retention and training policies were not reviewed here, and vendor privacy statements are not treated as observed results.
